en.headline: Observatory issues Thunderstorm Warning until 7.30am
en.dek: The warning was issued at 4.42am after overnight thunderstorms; isolated storms are still expected at first before a hot, partly sunny day.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 4.42am on Tuesday, saying it would remain in force until 7.30am. Isolated thunderstorms were expected over Hong Kong at first.

The warning follows a separate Thunderstorm Warning that had been kept in force through Monday night until midnight. The Observatory's morning forecast called for a mainly cloudy day with a few showers, isolated thunderstorms early on, and sunny periods later, with a maximum temperature of around 32 degrees.

Winds were expected to be light at first, becoming moderate easterlies. The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek shelter if thunderstorms developed, to leave the water and avoid outdoor swimming, and to stay off high ground and away from trees and metal masts.
The outlook was for mainly fine weather over the next few days, with a northeast monsoon keeping conditions hot.

zh.headline: 天文台清晨再發雷暴警告 有效至上午7時30分
zh.dek: 天文台周二上午4時42分發出雷暴警告，有效至7時30分，預料本港初時仍有局部地區雷暴。
body: 香港天文台星期二上午4時42分發出雷暴警告，有效時間至上午7時30分，預料香港初時有局部地區雷暴。
警告是在周一晚間雷暴警告於午夜結束後再發出。天文台早間預報指，今日大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，初時有局部地區雷暴，日間部分時間有陽光，最高氣溫約32度。
風力初時微弱，稍後轉吹和緩東風。天文台提醒市民，雷暴發生時如身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿進行戶外游泳或其他水上活動，亦不要站在高地或靠近樹木、桔杆等導電物體。
展望未來數日天氣大致良好，東北季候風影響下仍然炎熱。
